display_long_description:
Space Atlas VR is your interactive guide to Space and Space Exploration. Journey through the Solar System, visit the surfaces of the Moon and Mars, interact with accurate maps of nearby stars and known exoplanets, and explore 3D models and mission timelines of various space exploration systems. Space Atlas VR provides a wealth of fascinating information about space through different immersive environments and a user interface that supports both hand tracking and controllers.

Space Atlas VR is organized into three main chapters: [1] The Earth: observe our planet from space, learn about the artificial satellites orbiting it, and discover details about our Moon. [2] The Solar System: an accurate 3D model of our solar system, where the positions and movements of celestial bodies are based on NASA simulation data. Visit these celestial bodies and delve into technical details of various exploration missions. [3] The Universe: a series of immersive environments to understand our place in the cosmos, including a precise 3D map of all stars within 30 light-years, a detailed representation of our galaxy—the Milky Way, a comprehensive 3D map of known exoplanets, and a model of the Local Group, the region of space that includes our galaxy and its neighbors.

This is the FREE DEMO version of Space Atlas VR (2025). To access all available content, download the constantly expanding and improving FULL VERSION.
